signatures.description: Design a multi-region passkey credential-rotation service that accepts concurrent registrations and revocations while replicas may deliver retries and stale updates out of order. Define an epoch-based state machine and implement deterministic conflict resolution that prevents a revoked credential from being resurrected, while preserving valid concurrent additions and producing an auditable replay log.
